objective: Authorize one bounded formal evaluation-only pressure diagnostic at 200 Mbps, loading one already verified checkpoint per learning path, to measure descriptive congestion, backlog, directional link utilization, and packet latency under the fixed M-Lab measurement-proxy burst.
context: This matrix changes only the offered load from the verified 100 Mbps medium pilot to the previously calibrated 200 Mbps pressure candidate; topology, cadence, star configuration, MCS, control plane, seed, checkpoint bytes, and measurement-proxy endpoint selection remain fixed.

The six cells form three exact two-cell pairs: pressure-ddqn, pressure-gat, and pressure-mpnn. Each pair contains one independently named Q-learning copy arm and one comparison arm, while all cells share the same trace identity; the three planned contrasts are descriptive single-seed pressure differences, not superiority tests.
The purpose is to identify whether the pressure trace exposes a measurable congestion regime before Q0 attribution and new-scheme design. It is not a final E0 threshold or paper result.
allowed_inputs: The exact clean main commit containing this matrix and its accepted finalization
excluded_inputs: Any modified, renamed, or unbound checkpoint file
Any trace other than the compiled 200 Mbps M-Lab measurement-proxy trace
Post-hoc load, seed, endpoint, topology, or resource changes
Any claim of algorithm superiority, causal congestion-control effect, final E0 threshold, Q0 optimality, or paper-ready statistical generalization
deliverables: A machine-recomputed authorization decision bound to six pressure evaluation cells in three exact pairs, exact checkpoint artifacts, immutable trace identity, and accepted review finalization
One serial natural-end VM receipt per pressure cell with exact checkpoint-loaded evidence, conservation, packet fates, directional capacity ledgers, and latency fields
A V2 analysis artifact that recomputes the three descriptive pressure contrasts from raw receipts, plus persisted verification
A short evidence note recording whether the pressure trace is suitable for the next Q0/congestion-design stage
cannot_claim: This single-seed pressure diagnostic does not establish that any algorithm is better than another.
It does not establish a causal congestion-control mechanism, a final E0 threshold, Q0 optimality, or paper-ready statistical significance.
A run that retrains, silently falls back, loses conservation, or loads a checkpoint without the declared source SHA cannot be counted.
acceptance: The authorization binds the exact compiled request, run manifest, analysis request, resolved configs, checkpoint bytes, sibling metadata, clean deployed main SHA, and this finalization.
All six cells run serially on the same deployed SHA and compiled 200 Mbps M-Lab trace identity, with learning.mode=eval and zero training steps.
Each cell has natural_end=true, conservation_ok=true, research_eligible=true, receipt verification success, exact loaded checkpoint SHA/metadata SHA, and the required physical ledger fields.
The three planned pressure contrasts are recomputed from raw artifacts and persisted verification returns ok=true with no errors.
If any cell fails, execution stops at that cell and the matrix is not treated as complete until the failure is repaired and the affected cell is rerun.
